name: ayurtrace-fabric-relay
description: Bridges Supabase (existing AyurTrace+ operational database) to a real Hyperledger Fabric network. Receives Supabase Database Webhooks on batches/products writes, submits the corresponding chaincode transaction, and writes the real Fabric tx id back to Supabase. herbchain_web and herbchain_backend are both completely unaware this service exists — additive only.
